.splashname{font-family:var(--font-splash);font-size:var(--ss);font-weight:var(--sw);letter-spacing:var(--ls);line-height:1;direction:ltr;animation:namein .9s ease-out both}
@keyframes namein{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.scrollhint{margin-top:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;min-height:44px;border:none;background:transparent;color:#B7BCD6;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}

@keyframes nudge{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(7px)}}
.stage{position:relative;width:300px;height:340px;flex:none}
.stage3d{width:min(680px,100%);height:420px;flex:none;cursor:grab;touch-action:pan-y}
.stage3d:active{cursor:grabbing}
.cart3d{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.cart{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:20px;z-index:2;animation:cartbob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.peek,.food{position:absolute;left:calc(50% + var(--bx));margin-left:-24px;font-size:46px;line-height:1;z-index:1;font-family:'Apple Color Emoji','Segoe UI Emoji','Noto Color Emoji',sans-serif}
.peek{top:166px;transform:rotate(var(--pr));animation:peek 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}

@keyframes hop{
  0%{transform:translate(0,10px) scale(.5) rotate(0);opacity:0}
  8%{opacity:1}
  30%{transform:translate(calc(var(--x)*.6),-190px) scale(1.05) rotate(var(--r));opacity:1}
  42%{transform:translate(var(--x),-150px) scale(1) rotate(calc(var(--r)*1.4));opacity:1}
  60%{transform:translate(calc(var(--x)*.4),-120px) scale(.95) rotate(calc(var(--r)*-.6));opacity:1}
  78%{transform:translate(0,10px) scale(.6) rotate(0);opacity:1}
  86%,100%{transform:translate(0,30px) scale(.5) rotate(0);opacity:0}
}
@keyframes peek{0%,100%{margin-top:0}50%{margin-top:-6px}}
